legend.0: Different activities: the later record belongs to another project, programme or component, even if the donor, country or sector is the same.
legend.1: Related, and possibly the same: the records share a programme or theme, but the later record may be a separate component, phase, new grant or sibling of the earlier one.
legend.2: Same activity: the later record is the same project or grant as the earlier record, reported again in a later year.
